status: WP-B0 stub. Engine wiring is final; every line here is PLACEHOLDER text to be replaced by the B1-B4 content passes.
_about: The Glimmerwell branch of Act 1 (NEXT_PLAN WP-B). Same shapes as the other data files: `slicePatch` (addObjs/replaceObjs on existing maps), `scenes`, `trainers`, `flags`. A scene `X@glimmer` runs instead of `X` while story.side is glimmer; a trainer `id@glimmer` is merged over `id`. The branch sets the SAME progression flags as the Keepers path (story.orchard_cleared, story.seal1, ...), so maps, gates, the quest chain and the region map need no per-side forks. No new maps. Edit this file freely: it is not a verbatim design copy.

addObjs._note: The orchard gate (the only way in). Tobin (9,14) faces up with sight 3, so (9,11)-(9,13) are his; the gate is the last tile where the player can still choose. Not gated on met_glimmerwell/met_fen: both pitch inside the scene, so the fork cannot be walked past.

lines.story.seal1: Bright Tier 1! Told you that you had the sparkle. Have a bright day!
lines.else: Crates packed, partners happy. The Hall is reviewing your file now. Have a bright day!

addObjs.name: Rook
addObjs._note: rook_fb and fb_teaser (maps_slice) key on seal:seal_fernbrook. These twins key on the lanyard so Rook's teaser (story.slice_end) fires on the glimmer path too. teaser@glimmer is B1 content.

side_pick: Tobin waves from the crates. Master Fen hurries up behind you.
Hi, {name}! These little ones are off to a Comfort Sanctuary. Help us pack, earn a Junior Bright lanyard!
Or help me keep them home. These trees are their family, {name}.
This decides who you travel with for a while. You can change course later, but it will cost you.
Thank you. Tobin won't listen to me. Perhaps he'll listen to a keeper with a strong team.
You step back from the gate.
Welcome to the partnership! Here, grab that crate lid.
You step back from the gate.
orchard@glimmer: You hold the lid. Tobin coaxes a Pomlet in with a Glimmer lantern. It goes quiet.
The Pomlet looks back at you.
Aw. They love that. Comfier already!
First day nerves! You'll get the hang of it.
{name}. I hoped you were different. Go on, then. The Hall will judge you, not I.
Fen walks back to the Hall without another word. The crates are loaded.
Great work! Head to the Hall. Partnership review, then your lanyard. Have a bright day!
seal1@glimmer: Review complete! This is your Bright Tier 1 lanyard. Wear it proudly, partner.
Welcome snacks, too. Brighter by nature! Have a bright day!

panel.greet: Welcome to the partnership review, {name}! Master Fen has agreed to one match.
panel.again: Your file is complete, partner. Have a bright day!

lines.intro: You chose their lamps over my trees. Show me the orchard taught you nothing, then.
lines.win: ...Strong. Stronger than I'd like. Take your ribbon and go.
lines.lose: Roots hold. Think about why, before you come back.

flags.story.side: "keepers" (default, absent on old saves) or "glimmer". Pledge, not permanent (BS adds switching).
flags.story.side_pick_done: The Fernbrook gate choice was made once.
flags.story.beat.<scene>: Set by the engine when a story beat (a scene that sets a story.* flag) finishes: which side played it.
flags.seals.seal_glim_1: Bright Tier 1 lanyard (the Glimmer Hall #1 stub). Sets story.seal1 through seal1@glimmer.
